games.description: Archived games, box scores and odds snapshots

notes: Dates are the first and last game_date present for that sport, derived from the data. Cached briefly, so `generatedAt` is when the figures were computed, not when you asked.
Coverage within a range is not guaranteed to be uniform. Backfilled datasets can be sparse at the edges, so probe a specific window before assuming density.
Player prop history is a backfilled dataset, not a live feed. For current lines use /api/v1/{sport}/props.
